1.05pm On the face of it, 268 does seem to be a touch under par, as pre-match a score

of this magnitude runs on the board is always important and Zimbabwe snuck in a lot of 
extra runs with that 25-run last wicket stand. The innings as a whole though is one West 
Indies would have been happy with, as they controlled proceedings in the early overs 
and then again at the death. However they were extremely sloppy in the field, grassing

excellent ground fielding. The excellent Alzarri Joseph was particularly unlucky with a 
majority of the chances spilled off his bowling.
